item.subject: science
item.stem:
Meera's grandmother plants a small piece of ginger with an eye into the soil of their garden in Nagpur. After some weeks, a new ginger plant grows from this piece.

Which statement best describes how the new ginger plant was produced?

options.A: By seeds formed after the mixing of instructions from two parent plants
options.B: By vegetative propagation, because a new plant grew from a part of one parent plant
options.C: By two parent plants exchanging pollen and producing fruit
options.D: By a seedling sprouting from a seed buried in the soil
